title: Metric view parameters are generally available
body: Parameters in [metric views](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views) are now generally available. Parameters bind values at query time, so a single metric view definition serves many query variants. Querying a metric view that defines parameters requires Databricks Runtime 18.2 or above. See [Use parameters with metric views](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/use-parameters).
